Sinclair, Inc.  
Retransmission Consent Election Notice for January 1, 2024 through December 31, 2026 
 
This statement serves as notice that, Sinclair, Inc. (“Sinclair”), as direct or indirect owner of each 
licensee listed below, and each licensee listed below for its associated station(s), hereby elects retransmission 
consent (to the extent applicable) on all MVPDs for carriage of the following stations in the following 
respective Designated Market Areas (“DMAs”) for the period beginning January 1, 2024 through and including 
December 31, 2026.  With respect to each station, this election applies to all communities located wholly or 
partially in the station’s DMA, as well as to any areas outside of any such station’s DMA that is, or has been, 
added to such station’s television market pursuant to an FCC market modification.
